yuki (devex): Quick heads-up: Go quickstart has two issues that are causing confusion for users — hardcoded api key in snippet and using context.Background() without timeout. Newcomers run the sample and it hangs on network flaps.

Example in quickstart/go/README.md: ```go
// BAD: hardcoded key + no timeout + naive retry
client := redwood.NewClient("sk-live-xxxx")
ctx := context.Background()
for {
    resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, req)
    if err != nil {
        // naive retry
        time.Sleep(2 * time.Second)
        continue
    }
    fmt.Println(resp.Text)
    break
}
```

yuki (devex): This encourages checking keys into repos and the loop retries forever without jitter or max attempts. Also using Background() without a timeout will hang the process during network stalls.

marco (sdk): Agreed. I'll open a PR to replace the snippet. Proposed good pattern: ```go
// GOOD: read key from env + context with timeout + SDK retry helper
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
defer cancel()
resp, err := client.WithRetry(ctx, redwood.RetryOptions{MaxAttempts:5, Backoff: redwood.ExponentialJitter})
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
fmt.Println(resp.Text)
```

marco (sdk): I'll also update the sample-app to use the SDK retry wrapper, and remove any literal sk- strings from code fences.

tara (docs): CI already caught a problem: docs-link-checker flagged quickstart/go/README.md for containing a token-like string. https://ci.internal/jobs/5599

ci-bot: docs-lint: failure -> quickstart/go/README.md: suspicious token pattern at line 15.

yuki (devex): Can we add two docs-lint rules: 1) detect literal sk- tokens in fenced code blocks, 2) detect context.Background() usage in Go quickstarts (flag when used without WithTimeout nearby).

marco (sdk): Good plan. I'll add unit tests to the docs-validator to grep go code blocks for "context.Background()" and warn if no "WithTimeout" or "WithDeadline" in the same fence. Also adding a regex for sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{6,} to fail CI.

tara (docs): I'll update the getting-started page link targets and add a short troubleshooting note: "If the sample hangs, ensure your environment variable REDWOOD_API_KEY is set and your client uses a context with timeout."

yuki (devex): Opening issue #1137 and tagging @marco for the PR. Small change but reduces onboarding pain a lot. :raised_hands:
